Parameter.name: uvScale
Parameter.description: XY - scaler multiplication on triplnar projected uv's

Parameter.name: porosityBySmoothness
Parameter.description: X - porosityAtZeroRoughness\nY - porosityRoughnessSlope (set it to 0.0 if you don't want darkening)\nporosity = porosityAtZeroRoughness + roughness * porosityRoughnessSlope

Parameter.name: wetShininess
Parameter.description: X - how shiny a wet surface become

Parameter.name: colorTint
Parameter.description: saturate(diffuseColor + XYZ) - makes diffuseColor darker or brighter, XYZ - can be negative

Parameter.name: alphaShift
Parameter.description: X - offset in mBlendedAlpha.X alphaNoise texture used with smoothstep, controlled via vertexColor.A

Parameter.name: contrastLuminiosity
Parameter.description: used in order to tweak alphaMap\nX - contrast\nY - Luminiosity
